content:
Today, Optimism made strides in core protocol documentation with a new design document for Light CL (follow mode) in `kona-node`, while also optimizing the Cannon MIPS emulator and enhancing VM execution stability. Documentation efforts continued with updates to Solidity versions, and ongoing discussions across multiple repositories highlight the need to add missing Super DA error codes.

## 🚨 Needs Attention
- **Pull Requests to Review**:
    - [ethereum-optimism/design-docs#865](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/design-docs/pull/865): Himess requested a review for this PR related to Super DA error codes.
- **Urgent Discussions**:
    - [ethereum-optimism/design-docs#725](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/design-docs/issues/725): Discussion continues on adding missing Super DA error codes; Himess inquired about the live status and requested a review for PR #865.
    - [ethereum-optimism/docs#725](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/docs/issues/725): Discussion continues on adding missing Super DA Errors to the documentation; Himess inquired about the live status and requested a review of #865 if it is live.
    - [ethereum-optimism/optimism#725](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/725): Discussion continues on adding missing Super DA error codes; Himess asks for confirmation on whether the changes are live and requests a review of pull request #865.

## ✅ Completed Work
### Core Protocol & VM Enhancements
- A new public design document was added, detailing the Light CL (follow mode) as implemented in `kona-node`, enhancing protocol documentation. ([ethereum-optimism/design-docs#359](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/design-docs/pull/359))
- The `SupportWorkingSysGetRandom` feature flag for Go 1.24 was removed, permanently enabling `SysGetRandom` support within the Cannon MIPS emulator, streamlining the codebase. ([ethereum-optimism/optimism#18624](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18624))
- A configurable timeout mechanism was added to the `vm-runner` to prevent indefinite hanging during VM execution, improving the robustness of the `run-trace` command. ([ethereum-optimism/optimism#18594](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18594))

## 🏗️ Work in Progress
### New Pull Requests
- **ethereum-optimism/docs**:
    - Update Solidity versions in documentation. ([#1941](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/docs/pull/1941))

## 🐞 Issue Triage
### Closed Issues
- **ethereum-optimism/optimism**:
    - The issue tracking the removal of Go 1.24 feature flags, specifically related to Cannon version 8, has been closed, indicating successful implementation. ([#17178](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/17178))
